about_short_description.short_description: HigherMe uses data and video to help retail and service employers find, screen, and hire better employees faster.

product.name: Applicant Tracking System
product.description: A platform to manage the hiring process including job postings, candidate screening, interview scheduling, and candidate evaluation.

product.name: Text-to-Apply
product.description: A tool that allows candidates to apply for jobs by sending a text message or scanning a QR code, enabling mobile and on-the-go applications.

product.name: Paperless Onboarding
product.description: A digital onboarding solution that enables new hires to complete required paperwork and forms before their first day.

product.name: Custom Data Exports and Integrations
product.description: Tools to export HR data in customizable formats and integrate hiring data with payroll and HR software platforms.

product.name: Background Screening Integrations
product.description: Integrated background check services embedded within the onboarding process to verify candidate eligibility and compliance.

product.name: Job Board Posting and Boosting
product.description: A service to post job openings across multiple job boards and boost job ads to increase applicant reach.
